crossRefs.note: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said…
Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to…
Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

translations.web: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
translations.bsb: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”
translations.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
translations.asv: and he hath seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.
